services.name: Morning Cruise
services.desc: Start your day on calm, glassy waters with a refreshing morning sail on Lake Tahoe — complete with complimentary drinks and our signature mimosas.

services.name: High Noon Cruise
services.desc: Soak up the sunshine on a vibrant midday sail across Lake Tahoe, complete with complimentary drinks and wide-open alpine views.

services.name: Afternoon Cruise
services.desc: Unwind on a relaxed afternoon sail across Lake Tahoe with complimentary drinks, mountain views, and sunshine stretching into golden hour.

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Sail into golden hour on Lake Tahoe with champagne skies, mountain reflections, good company, and a glass in hand as the sun melts into the horizon.

services.name: Blue Private Charter (Small Group)
services.desc: Create your own unforgettable Lake Tahoe sailing experience with a fully private charter, complimentary drinks included.

services.name: Catamaran Morning Cruise
services.desc: Stunning sunset sail with beer and wine available for purchase. Duration 2 hours Schedule Daily: 4:00PM May, September and October Daily: 6:00PM June, July and August About Hop aboard our new 50' sailing Catamaran "Blue Zephyr". Beverages such as local beer, wine, and non-alcoholic beverages available for purchase. Please note that our sailboat is powered by the wind, so our route for the two-hour public cruise is wind-dependent and varies depending on the wind strength and direction. Location Ski Run Marina 900 Ski Run Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150, United States What to Bring Light layers & camera.
